column2:
safety(n.)安全
safe(adj.)安全的
safely(adv.)安全地
safety belt 安全帶
for safety reasons 基於安全理由
Safety comes first.
(安全第一。)
Wear a helmet for your own safety.
(為了你自己的安全，請戴安全帽。)

sail(v./n.)航行、帆
sailing(n.)帆船運動、航行
set sail 啟航
sail across 航行橫越
The ship sailed across the ocean.
(那艘船橫越大海。)
They set sail early in the morning.
(他們一大早就啟航了。)

sailor(n.)水手、船員
sail(v./n.)航行、帆
a young sailor 年輕水手
sailor suit 水手服
The sailor has been to many countries.
(那位水手去過很多國家。)
The sailors worked hard on the ship.
(水手們在船上辛勤工作。)

salesperson(n.)售貨員、業務員
salesman(n.)男售貨員、男業務員
saleswoman(n.)女售貨員、女業務員
car salesperson 汽車業務
a friendly salesperson 親切的店員
The salesperson showed me some new phones.
(那位店員給我看了一些新手機。)
My uncle works as a car salesman.
(我舅舅是汽車業務員。)

salty(adj.)鹹的
salt(n.)鹽
salty food 鹹的食物
taste salty 嚐起來鹹
This soup is too salty.
(這湯太鹹了。)
Eating salty food is bad for your health.
(吃太鹹的食物對健康不好。)

sample(n./v.)樣品、試吃、抽樣
(無詞性變化)
free sample 免費試用品
blood sample 血液樣本
The store gave out free samples of cake.
(那家店發送蛋糕試吃品。)
You can sample the food before you buy it.
(你可以先試吃再買。)

sand(n./v.)沙、用砂紙磨
sandy(adj.)沙質的
sand castle 沙堡
white sand 白沙
The kids built a sand castle on the beach.
(孩子們在沙灘上蓋沙堡。)
I got sand in my shoes.
(我的鞋子裡跑進了沙子。)

sandwich(n./v.)三明治、夾在中間
(無詞性變化)
ham sandwich 火腿三明治
be sandwiched between 被夾在……之間
I had a sandwich for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了一個三明治。)
My seat was sandwiched between two big men.
(我的座位被夾在兩個大塊頭中間。)

satisfy(v.)使滿意、滿足
satisfaction(n.)滿意
satisfied(adj.)感到滿意的
satisfy needs 滿足需求
be satisfied with 對……滿意
Nothing can satisfy him.
(沒有什麼能讓他滿意。)
I'm satisfied with my test score.
(我對我的考試成績很滿意。)

saw(v./n.)鋸、鋸子
(無詞性變化)
saw wood 鋸木頭
electric saw 電鋸
He used a saw to cut the wood.
(他用鋸子鋸木頭。)
Dad sawed the branch off the tree.
(爸爸把樹枝鋸了下來。)

scare(v./n.)驚嚇、恐慌
scary(adj.)可怕的
scared(adj.)害怕的
scare away 嚇跑
give someone a scare 嚇某人一跳
The loud noise scared the birds away.
(巨大的聲響把鳥嚇跑了。)
You gave me a scare!
(你嚇了我一跳！)

scared(adj.)害怕的
scare(v./n.)驚嚇
be scared of 害怕
scared to death 嚇得要死
My little sister is scared of dogs.
(我妹妹怕狗。)
I was scared to walk home alone at night.
(我很怕晚上獨自走路回家。)

scene(n.)場景、現場、景色
scenery(n.)風景
scenic(adj.)風景優美的
behind the scenes 在幕後
the scene of the accident 事故現場
The police arrived at the scene quickly.
(警察很快就抵達現場。)
This is my favorite scene in the movie.
(這是我在電影中最喜歡的一幕。)

schedule(n./v.)時間表、行程、安排
(無詞性變化)
on schedule 按時
busy schedule 忙碌的行程
The train arrived on schedule.
(火車準時抵達。)
The meeting is scheduled for Friday.
(會議安排在週五。)

scooter(n.)機車、速克達
(無詞性變化)
ride a scooter 騎機車
electric scooter 電動機車
Many people in Taiwan ride scooters to work.
(台灣很多人騎機車上班。)
My dad bought an electric scooter.
(我爸爸買了一台電動機車。)

score(n./v.)分數、得分
scorer(n.)得分者
high score 高分
score a goal 射門得分
She got a high score on the English test.
(她英文考試考了高分。)
He scored two goals in the game.
(他在比賽中踢進兩球。)

screen(n.)螢幕、屏風
(無詞性變化)
computer screen 電腦螢幕
big screen 大螢幕
Don't look at the screen for too long.
(不要盯著螢幕太久。)
We watched the game on a big screen.
(我們在大螢幕上看比賽。)

seafood(n.)海鮮
(無詞性變化)
seafood restaurant 海鮮餐廳
fresh seafood 新鮮海鮮
Keelung is famous for its seafood.
(基隆以海鮮聞名。)
We had dinner at a seafood restaurant.
(我們在一家海鮮餐廳吃晚餐。)

search(n./v.)搜尋、尋找
(無詞性變化)
search for 尋找
in search of 尋找
I searched for the word online.
(我上網搜尋這個字。)
They went in search of the lost dog.
(他們去尋找走失的狗。)

secondary(adj.)次要的、中等(教育)的
(無詞性變化)
secondary school 中學
of secondary importance 次要的
Money is of secondary importance to him.
(對他來說錢是次要的。)
She teaches at a secondary school.
(她在一所中學教書。)

secret(adj./n.)祕密(的)
secretly(adv.)祕密地
keep a secret 保守祕密
in secret 祕密地
Can you keep a secret?
(你能保守祕密嗎？)
They had a secret meeting after school.
(他們放學後開了一場祕密會議。)

section(n.)部分、區域、段落
(無詞性變化)
sports section 體育版
the first section 第一部分
Please read the first section of the book.
(請讀這本書的第一部分。)
The library has a large science section.
(圖書館有一個很大的科學書區。)

seek(v.)尋找、尋求
(無詞性變化)
seek help 尋求協助
hide-and-seek 捉迷藏
You should seek help from your teacher.
(你應該向老師尋求協助。)
The children are playing hide-and-seek.
(孩子們在玩捉迷藏。)

seem(v.)似乎、看起來
(無詞性變化)
seem to 似乎
it seems that 看來
You seem tired today.
(你今天看起來很累。)
It seems that it will rain soon.
(看來快要下雨了。)

seesaw(n.)蹺蹺板
(無詞性變化)
play on the seesaw 玩蹺蹺板
ride a seesaw 坐蹺蹺板
The kids are playing on the seesaw.
(孩子們在玩蹺蹺板。)
There is a seesaw in the park.
(公園裡有一座蹺蹺板。)

seldom(adv.)很少、不常
(無詞性變化)
seldom see 很少見到
seldom go out 很少出門
My father seldom watches TV.
(我爸爸很少看電視。)
It seldom snows in Taipei.
(台北很少下雪。)

select(v./adj.)選擇、挑選、精選的
selection(n.)選擇、精選
selective(adj.)有選擇性的
select a team 挑選隊伍
a select group 精選的一群人
She was selected for the school team.
(她被選入校隊。)
Please select one answer.
(請選出一個答案。)

selection(n.)選擇、選拔、精選品
select(v.)選擇、挑選
a wide selection of 種類繁多的
natural selection 天擇
The store has a wide selection of shoes.
(那家店的鞋子種類很多。)
The selection of the new captain took a week.
(選出新隊長花了一個星期。)

self(n.)自己、自我
selfish(adj.)自私的
one's true self 真正的自我
self-confidence 自信
Just be your true self.
(做真正的自己就好。)
He's back to his old self again.
(他又恢復了原來的樣子。)

selfish(adj.)自私的
selfishness(n.)自私
unselfish(adj.)無私的
a selfish person 自私的人
selfish behavior 自私的行為
Don't be so selfish. Share your snacks.
(別那麼自私，分享你的零食吧。)
It was selfish of him to take all the cake.
(他把蛋糕全拿走真是太自私了。)

sense(n./v.)感覺、意義、察覺
sensible(adj.)明智的
sense of humor 幽默感
make sense 有道理
He has a great sense of humor.
(他很有幽默感。)
What you said doesn't make sense.
(你說的話沒有道理。)

sensitive(adj.)敏感的、體貼的
sensitivity(n.)敏感度
sensitive skin 敏感肌膚
be sensitive to 對……敏感
My skin is sensitive to the sun.
(我的皮膚對陽光很敏感。)
She is sensitive to other people's feelings.
(她很能體察別人的感受。)

separate(adj./v.)分開的、分開
separation(n.)分離
separately(adv.)分別地
separate from 和……分開
separate rooms 分開的房間
Please separate the trash for recycling.
(請把垃圾分類以便回收。)
My brother and I have separate rooms.
(我和哥哥各有自己的房間。)

servant(n.)僕人、傭人
serve(v.)服務
civil servant 公務員
a loyal servant 忠實的僕人
The rich man had many servants.
(那個富人有很多僕人。)
My aunt is a civil servant.
(我阿姨是公務員。)

serve(v.)服務、供應(餐點)、任職
service(n.)服務
server(n.)服務生、伺服器
serve food 上菜
serve as 擔任
Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
(早餐供應時間是七點到十點。)
He served as class leader last year.
(他去年擔任班長。)

settle(v.)解決、定居、安頓、settlement(n.)解決、協議、定居地
(無詞性變化)
settle down 安頓下來
settle a problem 解決問題
They settled the problem quickly.
(他們很快就解決了問題。)
His family settled in Tainan many years ago.
(他的家人多年前在台南定居。)

sex(n.)性別、性
sexual(adj.)性的
sex education 性教育
the opposite sex 異性
Please write your name, age, and sex.
(請寫下你的姓名、年齡和性別。)
Our school offers sex education classes.
(我們學校有開性教育課程。)

shame(n./v.)羞恥、可惜、使丟臉
shameful(adj.)可恥的
ashamed(adj.)感到羞恥的
What a shame! 真可惜！
feel shame 感到羞愧
What a shame you can't come!
(你不能來真可惜！)
He felt shame for lying to his mom.
(他對媽媽說謊感到羞愧。)

shark(n.)鯊魚
(無詞性變化)
shark attack 鯊魚攻擊
great white shark 大白鯊
We saw a shark at the aquarium.
(我們在水族館看到一隻鯊魚。)
Sharks have very sharp teeth.
(鯊魚有非常銳利的牙齒。)

sheet(n.)床單、一張(紙)
(無詞性變化)
a sheet of paper 一張紙
change the sheets 換床單
Please take out a sheet of paper.
(請拿出一張紙。)
I change my bed sheets every week.
(我每週換床單。)

shelf(n.)架子、書架
shelves(n.)架子(複數)
book shelf 書架
on the shelf 在架子上
Put the books back on the shelf.
(把書放回書架上。)
The top shelf is too high for me.
(最上層的架子對我來說太高了。)

shell(n.)殼、貝殼
(無詞性變化)
sea shell 貝殼
egg shell 蛋殼
We collected shells on the beach.
(我們在海灘上撿貝殼。)
A turtle can hide in its shell.
(烏龜可以躲進殼裡。)

shine(v./n.)發光、照耀、擦亮、光澤
shiny(adj.)閃亮的
the sun shines 陽光照耀
shine a light 照亮
The sun is shining brightly today.
(今天陽光燦爛。)
Her eyes shone with joy.
(她的眼睛閃耀著喜悅。)

shock(n./v.)震驚、衝擊、使震驚
shocking(adj.)令人震驚的
shocked(adj.)感到震驚的
in shock 處於震驚中
culture shock 文化衝擊
The news came as a shock to us.
(這個消息令我們震驚。)
I was shocked by his rude words.
(我被他無禮的話嚇到了。)

shoot(v./n.)射擊、投籃、拍攝、嫩芽
shooter(n.)射手
shoot a film 拍電影
shoot the ball 投籃
He shot the ball and scored.
(他投籃得分。)
They are shooting a movie in our town.
(他們正在我們鎮上拍電影。)

shopkeeper(n.)店主
(無詞性變化)
a friendly shopkeeper 親切的店主
local shopkeepers 在地店家
The shopkeeper gave me a discount.
(店主給了我折扣。)
The shopkeeper knows all his customers.
(店主認識他所有的顧客。)

shore(n.)岸、海岸
(無詞性變化)
on the shore 在岸上
walk along the shore 沿著海岸走
We walked along the shore at sunset.
(我們在日落時沿著海岸散步。)
The boat came back to shore.
(那艘船回到岸邊。)

shot(n.)射擊、投籃、照片、注射
(無詞性變化)
take a shot 試一試、投籃
flu shot 流感疫苗
He made the winning shot.
(他投進致勝的一球。)
I got a flu shot last week.
(我上週打了流感疫苗。)

shut(v./adj.)關閉、關上的
(無詞性變化)
shut down 關閉
shut up 閉嘴
Please shut the door.
(請把門關上。)
The store was shut for the holiday.
(那家店因假期關門。)

shy(adj.)害羞的
shyness(n.)害羞
shyly(adv.)害羞地
be shy with 對……害羞
too shy to 太害羞而不敢
She is too shy to speak in class.
(她太害羞了，不敢在課堂上發言。)
He smiled shyly at the girl.
(他害羞地對那女孩微笑。)

sidewalk(n.)人行道
(無詞性變化)
on the sidewalk 在人行道上
walk on the sidewalk 走人行道
Please walk on the sidewalk.
(請走在人行道上。)
Scooters should not park on the sidewalk.
(機車不應該停在人行道上。)

silence(n./v.)寂靜、沉默、使安靜
silent(adj.)安靜的
in silence 沉默地
break the silence 打破沉默
We ate dinner in silence.
(我們默默地吃晚餐。)
Her joke broke the silence.
(她的笑話打破了沉默。)

silent(adj.)安靜的、沉默的
silence(n.)寂靜、沉默
silently(adv.)默默地
keep silent 保持沉默
silent film 默片
Please keep silent in the library.
(在圖書館請保持安靜。)
He stayed silent during the meeting.
(他在會議中一直保持沉默。)

silly(adj.)愚蠢的、傻的
(無詞性變化)
silly question 蠢問題
don't be silly 別傻了
Don't be silly. You can do it!
(別傻了，你做得到的！)
It was silly of me to forget my keys.
(我真傻，竟然忘了帶鑰匙。)

silver(n./adj.)銀、銀色(的)
(無詞性變化)
silver medal 銀牌
silver ring 銀戒指
She won a silver medal in swimming.
(她在游泳比賽中贏得銀牌。)
My mom has a silver ring.
(我媽媽有一枚銀戒指。)

similar(adj.)相似的
similarity(n.)相似處
similarly(adv.)同樣地
be similar to 和……相似
similar taste 相似的品味
My bag is similar to yours.
(我的包包和你的很像。)
We have similar interests.
(我們有相似的興趣。)

simply(adv.)簡單地、只是、簡直
simple(adj.)簡單的
simply put 簡單地說
simply because 只因為
Simply put, we need more time.
(簡單地說，我們需要更多時間。)
The view was simply beautiful.
(景色簡直美極了。)

single(adj./n./v.)單一的、單身的、單人的、挑出
(無詞性變化)
single room 單人房
every single day 每一天
I'd like to book a single room.
(我想訂一間單人房。)
He practices piano every single day.
(他每一天都練鋼琴。)

skill(n.)技能、技巧
skillful(adj.)熟練的
skilled(adj.)熟練的
language skills 語言能力
develop skills 培養技能
Cooking is a useful life skill.
(烹飪是一項實用的生活技能。)
She wants to improve her English skills.
(她想加強她的英文能力。)

skilled(adj.)熟練的、有技術的
skill(n.)技能
skilled worker 技術工人
be skilled at 擅長
He is skilled at fixing computers.
(他很擅長修電腦。)
The factory needs more skilled workers.
(這間工廠需要更多技術工人。)

skin(n.)皮膚、皮
(無詞性變化)
dry skin 乾性皮膚
banana skin 香蕉皮
Use sunscreen to protect your skin.
(用防曬乳保護你的皮膚。)
He slipped on a banana skin.
(他踩到香蕉皮滑倒了。)

sleepy(adj.)想睡的、寧靜的
sleep(v./n.)睡覺
feel sleepy 想睡
a sleepy town 寧靜的小鎮
I always feel sleepy after lunch.
(我午餐後總是很想睡。)
They live in a sleepy little town.
(他們住在一個寧靜的小鎮。)

slide(n./v.)滑梯、投影片、滑動
(無詞性變化)
slide down 滑下
slide show 投影片放映
The kids slid down the slide.
(孩子們從溜滑梯上滑下來。)
Let's look at the next slide.
(我們來看下一張投影片。)

slip(v./n.)滑倒、溜走、紙條、小錯誤
slippery(adj.)滑的
slip on 踩到……滑倒
slip of the tongue 口誤
Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
(小心別在濕地板上滑倒。)
Sorry, it was just a slip of the tongue.
(抱歉，那只是口誤。)

slipper(n.)拖鞋
slippers(n.)拖鞋(複數)
a pair of slippers 一雙拖鞋
put on slippers 穿上拖鞋
Please put on your slippers inside.
(在室內請穿上拖鞋。)
I bought a new pair of slippers.
(我買了一雙新拖鞋。)

smooth(adj./v.)光滑的、順利的、使平滑
smoothly(adv.)順利地
smooth skin 光滑的肌膚
go smoothly 進行順利
The baby has smooth skin.
(寶寶的皮膚很光滑。)
I hope everything goes smoothly.
(希望一切順利。)

snack(n./v.)點心、零食、吃點心
(無詞性變化)
snack bar 小吃店
late-night snack 宵夜
I often eat snacks while watching TV.
(我常常邊看電視邊吃零食。)
Let's have a late-night snack.
(我們來吃宵夜吧。)

snail(n.)蝸牛
(無詞性變化)
at a snail's pace 慢吞吞地
snail mail 傳統郵件
A snail moves very slowly.
(蝸牛移動得很慢。)
The traffic moved at a snail's pace.
(車流慢吞吞地前進。)

snowy(adj.)下雪的、積雪的
snow(n./v.)雪、下雪
snowy day 下雪天
snowy mountain 雪山
It was a cold and snowy day.
(那是一個寒冷的下雪天。)
We saw snowy mountains in Japan.
(我們在日本看到了雪山。)

soap(n./v.)肥皂、用肥皂洗
soapy(adj.)含肥皂的
a bar of soap 一塊肥皂
soap opera 肥皂劇
Wash your hands with soap.
(用肥皂洗手。)
My grandma loves watching soap operas.
(我奶奶很愛看連續劇。)

soccer(n.)足球
(無詞性變化)
play soccer 踢足球
soccer team 足球隊
We play soccer after school.
(我們放學後踢足球。)
He is on the school soccer team.
(他是學校足球隊的一員。)
